port.title: Port
port.description: The port senders connect to on the listener replica.

address.title: Bind address
address.description: The local address to bind; empty binds every address.

allow.title: Allowed senders
allow.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to connect; empty allows any.

maxMessagesPerSec.title: Maximum reports per second
maxMessagesPerSec.description: Across every sender; 0 means no limit.

maxMessagesPerSecPerSender.title: Maximum reports per second per sender

enforceCoverage.title: Refuse reports outside the emplacement's coverage

ownshipToleranceMs.title: Ownship tolerance (ms)
ownshipToleranceMs.description: How far past a mobile emplacement's newest position report its measurements may be placed.

backpressure.title: Backpressure policy
backpressure.description: A gRPC connection always blocks: each report is acked once it is queued.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: Certificates and keys come from the tlsCert, tlsKey and clientCa secrets, never from file paths.

requireClientCert.title: Require client certificates
requireClientCert.description: Mutual TLS, verified against the clientCa secret.
